title: Jamaican Flaxseed Chicken Tagine
description: A sweet and spicy chicken dish inspired by traditional Moroccan tagines, made with Jamaican jerk seasoning and flaxseed.
instructions: Heat oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add jerk seasoning, flaxseed, honey, and tagine spice mix. Stir to combine.
Add chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened, about 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
